note: Questions to ask after a review. every_job questions always show. The family lists fill the 'From this spec' list after any questions about failed or unclear items.

utility: Has the power company signed off on the metering layout, or do they have their own standard we must follow?
Where does the power company's cable come in, top or bottom, and who supplies the cable ends?
Will the power company supply the meter and CTs, or do we?
transformer: What load will the transformer carry on a normal day, and how much growth do you expect in the next five years?
Is there a noise limit at the site, like a property line or nearby offices?
What secondary voltage and winding connection do you need?
bus: How long is the run, and how many bends or wall crossings does it have?
What equipment does the bus connect to at each end, and who supplies the end connections?
Will any part of the run be outdoors or pass through a fire wall?
switchgear: Can you send the one-line diagram so we can match the number and size of breakers?
How much room is there in front of and behind the lineup to open doors and pull breakers?
Do you want space saved in the lineup for breakers you may add later?
ups: How much of the load must stay on during an outage, and how long does it need to run on battery?
Will this UPS run alone or side by side with other UPS units?
What battery type do you prefer, and how many years should it last?
rack: What is the heaviest loaded rack you plan to install, and will racks be moved while loaded?
How will power get to each rack: overhead busway or cables under the floor?
How much power per rack do you expect now and in three years?
every_job: What date does the equipment need to be on site, and is there a penalty if it is late?
Do you have an approved vendor list or brand rules we should know about?
Who signs off on our drawings, and how long does that review usually take?

utility: Does the power company need to approve our drawings, and how long does that usually take?
Can our section fit the power company's meter and CT layout?
Do we have a test report for the short-circuit rating?
transformer: Do our loss numbers meet the efficiency rules for this size of transformer?
Can we meet the sound level the site needs?
What is our lead time for this kVA size today?
bus: Do we need a site visit to measure the route before we quote?
Will the bus line up with the connection points on the equipment at each end?
Does this route need expansion joints or wall seals?
switchgear: Do we have a test report for the short-circuit rating that we can send to the customer?
Will the lineup fit on one truck, or does it ship in sections that join on site?
Do we need extra sections for all the breakers on the one-line?
ups: Will the battery cabinets fit in the room, and how much cooling do they need?
Can our UPS run in parallel with their existing units?
Is the battery runtime still met at the end of battery life?
rack: Was the load rating tested on wheels or on leveling feet?
Can our racks hold the full load on casters, or only on leveling feet?
Do our racks fit their aisle containment?
every_job: What is our real lead time today, not the catalog number?
If we offer our standard option where the spec differs, how do price and lead time change?
Is anything in this spec something we have not built before?
